fields.label: Recent frame rows
fields.help: Maximum number of recent DMR voice-frame rows kept in the browser view.

fields.label: Show raw frame hex
fields.help: Show the 33-byte DMR frame payload as hexadecimal for bridge testing.

fields.label: Show coded AMBE channel blocks
fields.help: Show the three most recent 72-bit coded AMBE+2 channel/FEC blocks.

fields.label: Show recovered 49-bit frames
fields.help: Show the three most recent recovered 49-bit AMBE+2 vocoder frames and FEC correction counts.

fields.label: Capture ring seconds
fields.help: Approximate amount of recovered AMBE frame history kept in the browser for Export Capture. The ring is bounded and never written to the Pi.

fields.label: Frame source
fields.help: Show both directions or only RF / network frames.
